crossRefs.note: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be?…
“You, son of man, the Lord Yahweh says to the land of Israel, ‘An end! The end has come on the four corners of the land.
“In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

parallels.note: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

translations.web: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
translations.bsb: So also, when you see all these things, you will know that He is near, right at the door.
translations.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
translations.asv: even so ye also, when ye see all these things, know ye that he is nigh, even at the doors.
